decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is peripheral to the firm's differentiated infrastructure strengths and in a crowded market its resources are better redirected to core network, cloud and software-defined services.
A metropolitan data centre connection network fits the firm's owned fibre and cloud-oriented strategy well and has already shown concrete adoption, so it remains strategically valuable.
A voice number ordering portal supports automation, self-service and real-time provisioning for enterprise communications, even if the underlying voice segment is mature.
